page.overview:
What is Ancient Crypt?

Ancient Crypt is an elven ruin found underneath the northern mountains of Ard Skellig, spanning from the northern island shores almost all the way to the village of Rogne, where it has a second exit.

Many treasure hunters have wanted to scavenge the crypt, but it was magically sealed from both ends, in order to protect the Sunstone - a powerful elven relic, which Geralt eventually managed to retrieve with the help of Philippa Eilhart.
